instruction.text: Katya uses these number machines to calculate the number of ill children for each week of a sickness bug. Complete the number machine for week 5.
Jane uses these number machines to work out a running programme. Complete the number machine for month 6.
Charlie uses these number machines to calculate the areas of different squares from their perimeters. Complete the number machine for a square with a perimeter of 24 cm.
Roger uses these number machines to calculate the sum of interior angles for different shapes. Complete the number machine for a pentagon.
A builder uses these number machines to calculate the number of tiles needed to create different numbers of patterns. Complete the number machine for 11 patterns.
Charlie uses these number machines to calculate the areas of different similar triangles. Complete the number machine for a base length of 8 cm.
instruction.sound: Charlie uses these number machines to calculate the areas of different similar triangles. Complete the number machine for a base length of 8 centimetres.

instruction.text: Joanna uses these number machines to work out how many potatoes she will harvest each week. Complete the number machine for week 2.
Raymond uses these number machines to calculate the number of corners he should put on a mountain biking course. Complete the number machine for a 2 mile course.
